description: Fires a concentrated bolt of superheated plasma at an enemy target.
Discharges an EMP wave across all hostiles with a chance to stun.
Project an energy barrier that bolsters defense for all party members.
Flash-freezes a target dealing high damage and slowing their action speed.
Unleashes raw unrefined arcana to obliterate all enemy ranks.
Deploys medical nanites to rapidly repair organic or mechanical tissue.
Injects combat stimulants into an ally to boost action speed.
Erects a consecrated defensive matrix protecting the whole party.
Restores a fallen or severely damaged party member back to peak vitals.
Smites hostiles with a burst of holy solar energy.
Sprays volatile acid that erodes armor plating on all foes.
Deploys toxic fumes that poison enemy ranks over time.
Releases airborne restoratives to patch up an ally's HP and Energy.
Blankets the party in thermal smoke to boost evasion against attacks.
Breaks down a single target at the molecular level for massive damage.
Pierces an enemy's consciousness with a sharp psionic shockwave.
Drains energy from an opponent and disrupts their spellcasting.
Emits a mental concussive pulse that can stun all hostiles.
Overloads a target's neural network to inflict devastating damage.
Scrambles enemy sensors reducing their attack accuracy.
